mapper.select: SELECT id, model_id, benchmark_name, score, percent_val, category FROM model_metrics WHERE model_id = #{modelId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, model_id, benchmark_name, score, percent_val, category FROM model_metrics ORDER BY percent_val DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_metrics (model_id, benchmark_name, score, percent_val, category) VALUES (#{modelId}, #{benchmarkName}, #{score}, #{percentVal}, #{category})
